evals.name: add-to-existing
evals.prompt: put paper towels and coffee on my costco list
evals.expected_output: Two items added to Costco with their history entries, nothing else touched, a one-line reply.
expectations: Paper towels and coffee are each on the Costco list exactly once
The two new items have every field the page expects (list, text, done, created, doneAt, order)
Each new item has a history entry reading exactly Added “<item text>”, on costco, marked as written by claude
Nothing that was already there changed: existing items, lists and history are identical
The page was not republished
The reply is at most two lines and names the Costco list

evals.name: new-list-when-nothing-close
evals.prompt: add sponges to my hardware store list
evals.expected_output: No existing list is close to 'hardware store', so the list is made, sponges goes on it, and the reply says a list was made.
expectations: One new list was made, named for the hardware store, ordered after the existing lists
Sponges is on the new list, and on no other list
History has an entry for making the list and an entry for adding the item
Nothing that was already there changed
The reply tells the user a new list was made
The page was not republished

evals.name: ask-when-a-list-might-match
evals.prompt: put a furnace filter on my home depot list
evals.expected_output: There is a Hardware list that might be what 'home depot' means, so nothing is written and the reply asks which list.
expectations: Nothing was written: items, lists and history are identical to before
The reply asks the user a question
The reply names the Hardware list as the possible match
The live lists were read before answering

evals.name: duplicate-and-done
evals.prompt: we're out of milk and coffee, put them on the costco list
evals.expected_output: Coffee is already open on the list, so it is not added again. Milk is in Done, so it is unchecked instead of duplicated.
expectations: Coffee is on the Costco list once, not twice
The existing milk item was unchecked (done false, doneAt null) instead of a second one being added
History has an uncheck entry for the milk
The Costco list still has three items
The reply says coffee was already on the list

evals.name: delete-is-restorable
evals.prompt: take eggs off the shopping list
evals.expected_output: Eggs is deleted with a history entry whose snapshot lets the page restore it.
expectations: Eggs is gone from the Shopping list
Bread and Butter are untouched
History has a delete entry whose snapshot can restore Eggs: its original id and every original field
The reply is at most two lines
The page was not republished

evals.name: set-up-from-nothing
evals.prompt: can you make me a checklist for the camping trip? tent, stove, headlamps so far
evals.expected_output: No list page exists yet: one is published with a database, and the items are seeded through the database, not written into the page.
expectations: Exactly one artifact was published, with a database capability
The published page does not hardcode the items; they live in the database
Tent, stove and headlamps each exist as a document in the page's database
The page was not pinned without the user being asked
The reply gives the user the page or says how to open it, in at most five lines
